simp_chinese: 汤顿围绕温彻斯特主教拥有的修道院发展。诺曼人于十二世纪将其重建为城堡。后来城镇见证了1497年沃贝克起事，以及1685年蒙茅斯自立为王。

english: Taupō occupies the northeastern shore of New Zealand’s largest freshwater lake. Its name is shortened from the Māori Taupō-nui-a-Tia, originally associated with a cliff at Pākā Bay on the lake’s eastern side.
simp_chinese: 陶波坐落在新西兰最大淡水湖的东北岸。名称缩自毛利语Taupō-nui-a-Tia，原本与湖泊东侧帕卡湾的一处峭壁有关。

english: Tauraba belongs to the wider Parita country of Panama. Before the Spanish conquest, Parita was the capital of a local kingdom; the later Spanish town was founded in 1556.
simp_chinese: 陶拉巴属于巴拿马更广阔的帕里塔地区。西班牙征服前，帕里塔是一座当地王国的都城，后来的西班牙城镇建立于1556年。

english: Tauragė stands on Lithuania’s Jūra River near the Baltic border country. First mentioned in 1507, it expanded substantially during the nineteenth century. Its surviving former customs building recalls its place near the imperial frontier.
simp_chinese: 陶拉盖位于立陶宛尤拉河畔、靠近波罗的海边界地区。1507年首见记录，十九世纪显著扩展。留存的旧海关建筑使人想起它靠近帝国边境的位置。

english: Tauramena lies in Colombia’s Casanare country. A tropical monsoon climate brings a relatively dry season from December to March followed by much heavier rains through most of the rest of the year.
simp_chinese: 陶拉梅纳位于哥伦比亚卡萨纳雷地区。热带季风气候使十二月至三月相对干燥，而一年其余大部分时段降雨显著增多。

english: Tauranga stands beside a sheltered harbour in the Bay of Plenty. Māori settlement dates to the late thirteenth century, while Europeans arrived in the early nineteenth. Its Māori name means Resting Place or Anchorage.
simp_chinese: 陶朗加位于丰盛湾一处避风港湾旁。毛利人于十三世纪后期定居，欧洲人于十九世纪初到来。毛利语地名意为休息地或锚地。

english: Takuu, also known as Tauu, is an isolated atoll northeast of Bougainville. Its reef supports a chain of very low islands, with most residents living on the small island of Nukutoa.
simp_chinese: 塔库又称陶乌，是布干维尔东北方的偏远环礁。礁体上分布一串极低平岛屿，多数居民生活在小型努库托阿岛。

english: These waters adjoin the wider Solomon Islands archipelago, which includes Bougainville. The island world lies in Melanesia northeast of Australia.
simp_chinese: 这片海域邻接包含布干维尔岛在内的广义所罗门群岛。这片岛屿世界位于澳大利亚东北方的美拉尼西亚。

english: Tavan belongs to the lower Dnieper country associated with Oleshia. The wider region supported fishing and trade along the route linking the Varangians with the Byzantine world.
simp_chinese: 塔万属于与奥列西亚相关的第聂伯河下游地区。更广区域在联系瓦良格人与拜占庭世界的道路上支撑着渔业和贸易。

english: Tavan Tolgoi belongs to the eastern Gobi region of Mongolia. Across the wider Mongolian Plateau, grassy steppe gives way to the Gobi in the south; this landscape formed part of the homeland of successive nomadic empires, including the empire founded by Genghis Khan in 1206.
simp_chinese: 塔奔陶勒盖位于蒙古东部戈壁地区。在更广阔的蒙古高原，草原向南过渡为戈壁；这片土地是历代游牧帝国活动的故土，其中包括成吉思汗于1206年建立的蒙古帝国。

english: Tavaputs belongs to the wider Rocky Mountain landscape. This great North American mountain system arose during the Laramide mountain-building episode, when tectonic plates moved beneath the continent.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦普茨属于更广阔的落基山景观。这一北美大山系在拉拉米造山运动中形成，当时构造板块向大陆下方俯冲。

english: Tavas occupies a broad plain near Kale in southwestern Anatolia. In antiquity this country belonged to Caria, while the mound of Medet Höyük preserves evidence of much earlier settlement.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦斯占据安纳托利亚西南部卡莱附近的宽阔平原。古代属于卡里亚地区，梅代特霍于克土丘则保存着更早定居的证据。

english: Tavashay belongs to the Ayoreo country of the Gran Chaco. The wider people traditionally lived as mobile hunters and gatherers between the Paraguay, Pilcomayo, Parapetí and Grande rivers, speaking a language of the Zamucoan family.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦沙伊属于大查科阿约雷奥人地区。更广阔的族群传统上在巴拉圭河、皮尔科马约河、帕拉佩蒂河与格兰德河之间以流动狩猎采集生活，使用萨穆科语系语言。

english: Tavastehus, or Hämeenlinna, lies beside Lake Vanajavesi in the heart of historical Tavastia. Its medieval castle gave the settlement a lasting regional importance. The later town also became the birthplace of composer Jean Sibelius.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦斯特胡斯又称海门林纳，位于历史塔瓦斯蒂亚腹地的瓦纳亚韦西湖旁。中世纪城堡赋予聚落持久的地区意义。后来的城镇也成为作曲家让·西贝柳斯的出生地。

english: Tavayveem belongs to the southern Chukchi Peninsula country facing the Bering Sea. The wider peninsula reaches Cape Dezhnev at its eastern tip, where Eurasia approaches North America across the Bering Strait, creating a meeting of Arctic lands and waters.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦伊维姆属于面向白令海的楚科奇半岛南部地域。广阔半岛向东延伸至杰日尼奥夫角，欧亚大陆在这里隔白令海峡接近北美，形成北极陆地与海洋的交会处。

english: Tavdinsky Sloboda belongs to the country around Tobolsk. In the wider region, Tobolsk was founded in 1587 near the Tobol–Irtysh confluence and developed into the historic Russian capital of Siberia.
simp_chinese: 塔夫金自由村属于托博尔斯克周围地区。在更广阔的区域，托博尔斯克于1587年建于托博尔河与额尔齐斯河交汇附近，并发展为俄罗斯西伯利亚的历史首府。

english: Taveewach lies in the broader Rocky Mountain landscape. Its regional setting is part of a chain of ranges and high intermontane basins stretching from western Canada toward New Mexico. Much of the mountain system arose during the Laramide orogeny, around fifty-five to eighty million years ago.
simp_chinese: 塔维瓦奇位于广义的落基山地景中。其区域背景是一连串山脉与高山间盆地，从加拿大西部向新墨西哥延伸。山系大部分形成于约五千五百万至八千万年前的拉拉米造山运动。

english: Taveuni is a great shield-volcano island east of Vanua Levu in Fiji. The Somosomo Strait separates the two islands, while Taveuni rises beside the northern reaches of the Koro Sea.
simp_chinese: 塔韦乌尼是斐济瓦努阿岛以东的一座大型盾状火山岛。索莫索莫海峡将两岛分隔，塔韦乌尼耸立于科罗海北部边缘。

english: Tavira stands near the Gilão’s outlet on the eastern Algarve coast. Settlement reaches back to the late Bronze Age. Phoenicians established an early fortified centre here, leaving traces of one of western Iberia’s old maritime communities.
simp_chinese: 塔维拉位于阿尔加维东岸的吉朗河出口附近。定居历史可追溯至青铜时代晚期。腓尼基人在此建立早期设防中心，留下伊比利亚西部古老海上社群的痕迹。

english: Taviwac belongs to the San Luis Valley country around the Rio Grande. The modern regional centre of Alamosa stands beside that river in south-central Colorado. Alamosa itself arose as a railway town in 1878, a much later chapter than the Indigenous landscape represented by Taviwac.
simp_chinese: 塔维瓦克属于格兰德河周围的圣路易斯谷地区。现代地区中心阿拉莫萨位于科罗拉多中南部的河畔。阿拉莫萨本身于1878年兴起为铁路城镇，远晚于塔维瓦克所代表的原住民景观。

english: Tavoy, now Dawei, is a port at the head of an estuary leading to the Andaman Sea. Monsoon floods frequently affect the low-lying riverside city. Its name is also shared by one of Burma’s recognised ethnic communities.
simp_chinese: 土瓦今称达维，是通向安达曼海的河口顶端港城。季风洪水常影响低洼河畔地区。这个名称也用于缅甸一支受承认的族群。

english: Tavrenga belongs to the Velsk country of northern Russia. At the wider district’s centre, the Vel joins the Vaga, and Velsk developed as a merchant town along river routes and the road between Moscow and Arkhangelsk.
simp_chinese: 塔夫伦加属于俄罗斯北部韦利斯克地区。在整个地区的中心，韦利河汇入瓦加河，韦利斯克凭借河流路线及莫斯科至阿尔汉格尔斯克道路发展为商贸城镇。

english: Tavşanlı lies in the Kütahya country of western Anatolia. Modern coal mining drew settlers from surrounding villages, while jewellery shops and roasted chickpeas became characteristic parts of the town's commerce.
simp_chinese: 塔夫尚勒位于安纳托利亚西部屈塔希亚地区。近现代煤矿吸引周边村民迁入，珠宝店与烤鹰嘴豆则成为城镇商业的特色。

english: The Tawahka form one of the Mayangna people's ethnolinguistic groups. Mayangna communities inhabited much of the Mosquito Coast in the sixteenth century and maintained river settlements, including along the Patuca in Honduras; the rise of Miskito power later narrowed their influence.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦卡人是马扬格纳人的一个民族语言群体。十六世纪，马扬格纳人居住于蚊子海岸大片地区，并沿河建立聚落，包括洪都拉斯的帕图卡河流域；米斯基托势力兴起后，他们的影响范围逐渐缩小。

english: The Tawahka Jungle belongs to the Mayangna country of eastern Central America. Tawahka are one of the Mayangna ethno-linguistic groups, whose wider communities occupy remote river settlements in Nicaragua and Honduras.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦卡丛林属于中美洲东部的马扬格纳地区。塔瓦卡是马扬格纳的语言族群之一，更广阔的社群居住于尼加拉瓜与洪都拉斯偏远的沿河聚落。

english: The Tawakoni are a Caddoan-speaking people closely related to the Wichita. Early eighteenth-century villages raised maize and tobacco, while conflict with the Osage helped drive communities south from Oklahoma into Texas.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦科尼是与威奇托人关系密切的卡多语族群。十八世纪初村落种植玉米与烟草，同奥塞奇人的冲突则推动社群从俄克拉何马南迁得克萨斯。

english: Tawalimni belongs to the wider Northern Valley Yokuts country of California’s Central Valley. The region’s Yokutsan speech formed a network of related varieties, including Chawchila, Kechayi and Dumna.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦利姆尼属于加利福尼亚中央谷地更广阔的北谷约库特地区。当地约库特语形成彼此相关的语言网络，包括查乌奇拉、凯查伊与杜姆纳等变体。

english: The Tawandê belong to Brazil’s Nambikwaran linguistic world. Their language is closely related to Latundê and Lakondê. Its sound system includes distinctions between plain, creaky and nasal vowels.
simp_chinese: 塔万德人属于巴西南比夸拉语言世界。其语言与拉通德语、拉孔德语关系密切。语音系统区分普通元音、嘎裂元音与鼻化元音。

english: Tawang stands about three thousand metres above sea level north of the Tawang Chu valley. Its renowned Gelug monastery made it a Buddhist centre in the Himalayan borderlands historically administered from Tibet.
simp_chinese: 达旺位于达旺曲河谷以北，海拔约三千米。著名的格鲁派寺院使其成为喜马拉雅边疆的佛教中心，历史上曾受西藏行政管理。

english: Tawatinaw is a small hamlet of Alberta’s Westlock country. It lies roughly seventy kilometres north of Edmonton.
simp_chinese: 塔瓦蒂诺是艾伯塔韦斯特洛克地区的一座小村落。它位于埃德蒙顿以北约七十公里处。

english: Tawau faces Cowie Bay on southeastern Borneo. The coast passed through Bruneian and Sulu influence before British and Dutch claims overlapped in the nineteenth century and the modern port developed.
simp_chinese: 斗湖面向婆罗洲东南部科威湾。海岸先后受到文莱与苏禄影响，十九世纪英国和荷兰诉求交叠，随后现代港口逐渐形成。

english: The Taovaya were Wichita-speaking communities of the central Great Plains. In the eighteenth century groups moved south from Kansas toward Oklahoma and Texas. Maize, beans, melons and tobacco were cultivated alongside bison hunting, joining farming villages with the wider plains economy.
simp_chinese: 塔奥瓦亚人是大平原中部使用威奇托语的社群。十八世纪，部分群体从堪萨斯南迁至俄克拉何马和得克萨斯。玉米、豆类、瓜与烟草种植同猎野牛结合，使农业村落联系广阔平原经济。

english: Taweisha belongs to the Darfur country. The wider region is a semi-desert plateau around the volcanic Marrah Mountains, where the Daju established a kingdom by the twelfth century before the Tunjur succeeded them in the fourteenth.
simp_chinese: 塔韦沙属于达尔富尔地区。整个区域是围绕火山形成的马拉山脉的半沙漠高原，达朱人至迟在十二世纪已建立王国，十四世纪又被通朱尔人取代。

english: Tawokser belongs to the maritime homeland of the Kawésqar in Chilean Patagonia. Their historical territory extended through island country south of the Gulf of Penas, including Wellington, Santa Inés and Desolación islands.
simp_chinese: 塔沃克塞尔位于智利巴塔哥尼亚卡韦斯卡尔人的海洋故土。他们的历史地域延伸于佩纳斯湾以南诸岛，包括惠灵顿岛、圣伊内斯岛与德索拉西翁岛。

english: Tawokser Forest belongs to the southern Patagonian world of the Kawésqar, whose communities inhabited islands and peninsulas north and west of the Strait of Magellan. Wellington and Santa Inés formed part of that wider homeland. Contact with European sailors brought profound changes and devastating diseases.
simp_chinese: 塔沃克塞尔森林属于巴塔哥尼亚南部的卡韦斯卡尔人地域，其社群生活于麦哲伦海峡以北及以西的岛屿和半岛。惠灵顿岛与圣伊内斯岛也是这片广大故土的一部分。与欧洲航海者接触后，疾病与深刻的生活变迁接踵而至。

english: Tawergha lies near Misrata on Libya’s coastal plain. Palm groves and date production long formed its wealth, before fighting and forced displacement in 2011 devastated the town.
simp_chinese: 塔韦尔盖位于利比亚沿海平原、米苏拉塔附近。棕榈园与椰枣生产长期构成当地财富，2011年的战斗及强制迁离后来重创了城镇。

english: Taximaroa belongs to Michoacán, the western Mexican country once dominated by the Purépecha Empire. The regional name means place of the fishermen and refers to the fishing communities around Lake Pátzcuaro.
simp_chinese: 塔希马罗阿属于墨西哥西部的米却肯地区，这里曾由普雷佩查帝国主导。米却肯之名意为渔人之地，指帕茨夸罗湖周边的捕鱼社群。

english: Tayabas was a provincial capital on Luzon. Spanish colonial bridges, ancestral houses and sixteenth-century stone crosses preserve the town's older built landscape, while local production includes palm spirit and traditional sweets.
simp_chinese: 塔亚巴斯曾是吕宋岛上的省级首府。西班牙殖民桥梁、祖宅与十六世纪石十字架保存着旧城风貌，当地还生产棕榈酒和传统甜食。

english: Tayabas Bay opens south of Luzon around Marinduque and neighbouring islands. Its shores support fishing and boat routes serving Lucena and the surrounding region. Sea turtles nest along the bay, and whale sharks also occur in its waters.
simp_chinese: 塔亚巴斯湾在吕宋以南、马林杜克及邻近岛屿周围展开。沿岸支撑渔业及服务卢塞纳和周边的船运路线。海龟在湾岸筑巢，水域也有鲸鲨活动。

english: Tayaccasa belongs to Peru’s fertile Mantaro Valley. The river cuts between high mountain ranges, watering fields of potatoes, maize and vegetables. The wider valley contains many archaeological sites and links Jauja, an important pre-Columbian city, with Huancayo.
simp_chinese: 塔亚卡萨属于秘鲁肥沃的曼塔罗河谷。河流穿过高山之间，灌溉马铃薯、玉米和蔬菜田。广大河谷拥有众多考古遗址，连接着前哥伦布时期重镇豪哈与万卡约。

english: Tayan belongs to the lower Kapuas country of Borneo. The wider island straddles the equator and preserves extensive tropical rainforests with many endemic species.
simp_chinese: 戴燕属于婆罗洲的下卡普阿斯地区。婆罗洲横跨赤道，保存着广阔的热带雨林，拥有许多特有物种。

english: Al-Taybah belongs to the Deir ez-Zor region of eastern Syria. The regional centre stands on the Euphrates, and the surrounding country preserves a long settlement history associated with ancient Mesopotamian kingdoms such as Mari.
simp_chinese: 泰巴属于叙利亚东部代尔祖尔地区。地区中心坐落在幼发拉底河畔，周边土地具有悠久的聚落历史，与马里等古代美索不达米亚王国相联系。

english: Tayga lies in the wider drainage of the Angara. This major Siberian river carries Lake Baikal’s outflow across Irkutsk and Krasnoyarsk territory before joining the Yenisey.
simp_chinese: 泰加位于安加拉河更广阔的流域中。这条西伯利亚大河将贝加尔湖的出水带过伊尔库茨克与克拉斯诺亚尔斯克地区，最终汇入叶尼塞河。

english: Tayma is an ancient oasis at the western approaches to the Nafud desert. Its dependable water supply attracted travellers along routes linking Arabia with Mesopotamia, the Levant and the eastern Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 泰马是内夫得沙漠西侧入口的古老绿洲。稳定水源吸引着沿连接阿拉伯半岛、美索不达米亚、黎凡特及东地中海的道路往来的旅行者。

english: Taymylyr stands north of the Arctic Circle on the left bank of the Olenyok River. Reindeer herding, hunting and fishing form the basis of its local economy.
simp_chinese: 泰梅雷尔位于北极圈以北、奥列尼奥克河左岸。当地经济以驯鹿饲养、狩猎和捕鱼为基础。

english: Tayoltita is a town in the Durango country of northwestern Mexico. It serves as the centre of the San Dimas municipality.
simp_chinese: 塔约尔蒂塔是墨西哥西北部杜兰戈地区的一座城镇。它是圣迪马斯市镇的中心。

english: The Tairona cultural region linked the Caribbean coast with the slopes and highlands of Colombia’s Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. By the tenth and eleventh centuries, interconnected chiefdoms shared technologies and social practices within a complex system of production and exchange.
simp_chinese: 泰罗纳文化区域将加勒比海岸与哥伦比亚圣玛尔塔内华达山脉的山坡、高地相连。十至十一世纪时，相互联系的酋邦共享技术及社会习俗，形成复杂的生产与交换体系。

english: Taytay belongs to Palawan, the island chain stretching from Mindoro toward Borneo. The wider archipelago separates the South China Sea and Sulu Sea, and discoveries at Tabon Cave record human occupation more than fifty thousand years ago.
simp_chinese: 泰泰属于从民都洛向婆罗洲延伸的巴拉望岛链。整个群岛分隔南海与苏禄海，塔邦洞穴的发现记录了五万多年前的人类活动。

english: Tayxlama belongs to the Sahaptin-speaking country of the Pacific Northwest. Sahaptin communities occupied the Columbia River and its tributaries, with villages concentrated along major waterways.
simp_chinese: 泰赫拉马属于太平洋西北部使用萨哈普廷语的地区。萨哈普廷社群生活在哥伦比亚河及其支流沿岸，村落集中在主要水道旁。

english: Taza occupies the corridor between the Rif and Middle Atlas. Its fortified settlement and trading position linked Fez with the Algerian frontier, attracting successive Moroccan dynasties to this strategic passage.
simp_chinese: 塔扎占据里夫山与中阿特拉斯山之间的走廊。设防聚落与贸易位置连接非斯和阿尔及利亚边境，使历代摩洛哥王朝重视这条战略通道。

english: Tazewell belongs to the wider Virginian country between the Atlantic and the Appalachians. Across this region, the coastal plain gives way to the Piedmont foothills and the mountain landscapes farther west.
simp_chinese: 塔兹韦尔属于大西洋与阿巴拉契亚山脉之间的弗吉尼亚地区。这片广大地区由海岸平原过渡至皮德蒙特丘陵，再向西进入山地。

english: Tazin lies in the lake country of northern Saskatchewan. Its namesake lake occupies part of the Tazin River’s course, forming one of the linked water bodies of this northern Canadian landscape.
simp_chinese: 塔津位于萨斯喀彻温北部的湖区。同名湖泊处在塔津河河道上，是这片加拿大北方地貌中相互联系的水体之一。

english: Tazin Lake lies in the northern Canadian province of Saskatchewan. The Tazin River passes through the lake as part of its course.
simp_chinese: 塔津湖位于加拿大萨斯喀彻温北方地区。塔津河流经湖泊，形成河道的一部分。

english: Tazirbu is a Libyan oasis whose Toubou name means main seat. The ruins of a sultan’s castle stand near villages and palm groves, while a shallow central valley contains salt pools and saline ground.
simp_chinese: 塔济尔布是利比亚绿洲，图布语名称意为“主要驻地”。苏丹城堡遗址位于村落与棕榈林附近，中央浅谷则包含盐池与盐碱地。

english: Taznakht lies in southern Morocco’s Ouarzazate country. The road through the town connects Ouarzazate with Agadir.
simp_chinese: 塔兹纳赫特位于摩洛哥南部瓦尔扎扎特地区。穿城道路连接瓦尔扎扎特与阿加迪尔。

english: Tazroute is a small town and rural commune in northern Morocco’s Larache country. A census in 2004 counted more than six thousand inhabitants across the commune.
simp_chinese: 塔兹鲁特是摩洛哥北部拉腊什地区的小城镇和乡村市镇。2004年人口普查记录整个辖区有六千多名居民。

english: Tazzarine lies in Morocco’s Jbel Saghro country. Marabout tombs mark its religious landscape, while nearby Ait Ouazik preserves ancient rock carvings.
simp_chinese: 塔扎林位于摩洛哥萨格罗山地区。圣徒陵墓构成地方宗教景观，附近艾特瓦齐克则保存着古代岩刻。

english: Tbilisi grew beside the Kura as a capital of Georgian kingdoms. Its foundation is associated with Vakhtang I in the fifth century, and its position near Silk Road routes repeatedly drew competing powers.
simp_chinese: 第比利斯在库拉河畔发展为格鲁吉亚诸王国的都城。建城传统与五世纪瓦赫坦格一世相关，靠近丝路的地位也使各方势力反复争夺此地。

english: Tbilisskaya stands on the Kuban’s right bank northeast of Krasnodar. Formerly called Tiflisskaya, the settlement received its current form of the name in 1936 and serves as a district centre.
simp_chinese: 第比利斯卡亚位于克拉斯诺达尔东北方的库班河右岸。聚落旧称蒂弗利斯卡亚，1936年采用现名形式，并作为地区中心。

english: The Tboli country belongs to Mindanao, the great southern island of the Philippines. Across the island’s history, interior Lumad communities maintained animist traditions while Islamic sultanates and, later, Spanish missions transformed many coastal regions.
simp_chinese: 特博利地区属于菲律宾南部的大岛棉兰老。在该岛历史中，内陆卢马德社群保持万物有灵的传统，伊斯兰苏丹国以及后来的西班牙传教活动则改变了许多沿海地区。

english: Tboung Khmum lies east of Kampong Cham in Cambodia’s lower Mekong country. Its name evokes the bee’s precious jewel. The modern district is strongly associated with the extensive Chup rubber plantation, a later agricultural development that transformed much of its land.
simp_chinese: 特本克蒙位于柬埔寨湄公河下游地区、磅湛以东。地名使人联想到蜜蜂的珍贵宝石。现代地区与广大的朱布橡胶园紧密相连，这一较晚农业开发改变了大片土地。

english: Tcha shka-ózhäye belongs to the Natahéndé country of the arid southwest. Across the broader region, scarce and seasonal water shaped life, while drought-resistant foods such as tepary beans distinguished the cultural landscape from wetter Mesoamerica.
simp_chinese: 恰什卡奥扎耶属于西南干旱地带纳塔恩德地区。在更广阔的区域，稀少且季节性的水源塑造生活，特帕里豆等抗旱食物使其文化景观与湿润美索美洲有所区别。

english: Tchafolonguta belongs to the eastern Lunda country near the Mweru region. Across the wider Lunda Commonwealth, linked states shared political traditions with a central polity in Katanga. The title Mwane-a-Yamvu became associated with its paramount rulers.
simp_chinese: 查福隆古塔属于姆韦鲁区域附近东隆达地区。在广义隆达共同体中，相联诸国与加丹加核心政体共享政治传统。姆瓦内亚姆武称号与其最高统治者相联。

english: Tchakashapug belongs to the western James Bay country around the Albany River. The wider watershed has long been inhabited by Mushkegowuk, or Swampy Cree, whose extended-family bands gathered into larger groups during winter. The Hudson’s Bay Company founded Fort Albany at the river mouth in 1679 to trade with the region’s Indigenous inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 查卡沙普格属于詹姆斯湾西岸奥尔巴尼河地区。广阔流域长期由穆什凯戈沃克人，即沼泽克里人居住，以大家族为基础的群体在冬季聚为更大社群。哈德孙湾公司于1679年在河口建立奥尔巴尼堡，与地区原住民贸易。

english: Tchan Sansan belongs to the Dakota homeland of the northern interior plains. Eastern Dakota communities inhabited central Minnesota, northern Iowa and the eastern Dakotas, while their older traditions connected them with woodland hunting, canoe fishing and wild-rice gathering.
simp_chinese: 昌桑桑属于北部内陆平原的达科他人故土。东达科他社群分布在明尼苏达中部、爱荷华北部和达科他东部，其更早传统与林地狩猎、独木舟捕鱼和采集野生稻相联系。

english: Tchankasndata belongs to Iowa’s Nishabotna country. In the wider region, the first known inhabitants hunted and gathered in a glacial landscape more than thirteen thousand years ago.
simp_chinese: 钱卡斯达塔属于艾奥瓦的尼沙博特纳地区。在更广阔的区域，最早已知居民于一万三千多年前在冰川地貌中狩猎采集。

english: Tchesha belongs to the wider Texas landscape of south-central North America. This region has a Gulf of Mexico coastline and a long boundary with Mexico along the Rio Grande.
simp_chinese: 切沙属于北美中南部更广阔的得克萨斯地域。这片地区拥有墨西哥湾海岸线，并沿格兰德河与墨西哥形成漫长边界。

english: Tchikunga belongs to the eastern Lunda country. The wider Lunda commonwealth linked a Katangan center with states across northeastern Angola and northwestern Zambia. Dynastic traditions connect its paramount rulers with the Luba and give them the title Mwane-a-Yamvu.
simp_chinese: 奇昆加属于东隆达地区。广阔的隆达邦联将加丹加中心与安哥拉东北部、赞比亚西北部诸邦联系起来。王朝传统将最高统治者与卢巴相连，并赋予他们Mwane-a-Yamvu头衔。

english: Tchitogama belongs to the Péribonka river country north of Lac Saint-Jean. The wider region’s Innu name evokes a river removing sand; Jesuits François de Crespieul and Charles Albanel visited the river-mouth country in 1673.
simp_chinese: 奇托加马属于圣让湖以北佩里邦卡河地区。更广阔区域的因努语名称令人想到搬移沙子的河流，耶稣会士弗朗索瓦·德·克雷斯皮厄与查尔斯·阿尔巴内尔于1673年到访河口地区。

english: Tchó'kanä stands within the varied country now called Texas. At the regional scale, pre-contact Texas lay between Southwestern and Plains cultural spheres. Its northeastern river basins supported agricultural, mound-building Caddo communities, while other peoples occupied the coast and the western Rio Grande country.
simp_chinese: 乔卡纳位于如今称为得克萨斯的多样地域之中。从区域尺度看，欧洲人到来前的得克萨斯处在西南文化与平原文化之间。东北部河流盆地生活着从事农业、营建土丘的卡多人，沿海与西部格兰德河地区则由其他族群居住。

english: Tchoukafala belongs to the wider Chickasaw country of the southeastern woodlands. The Chickasaw homeland extended across northern Mississippi and adjoining parts of Alabama, Tennessee and Kentucky, and their language belongs to the Muskogean family.
simp_chinese: 乔卡法拉处于北美东南林地广义的奇克索地区。奇克索故土覆盖密西西比北部及阿拉巴马、田纳西、肯塔基邻接部分，其语言属于穆斯科吉语系。

english: Tconsiep belongs to the wider Prieska country along South Africa’s Orange River. The regional town developed at a place used by farmers after rain filled the pans, and its older Korana-derived name was interpreted as the place of the lost she-goat.
simp_chinese: 特孔西耶普位于南非奥兰治河沿岸广义的普里斯卡地区。地区城镇从雨后洼地积水时农民聚集之地发展起来，其源于科拉纳语的旧名被解释为走失母山羊之地。

english: Tczew gained town rights in 1260 and developed as a major Vistula river port. Grain commerce brought prosperity to this Pomeranian town.
simp_chinese: 特切夫于1260年获得城市权利，发展为维斯瓦河的重要河港。粮食贸易为这座波美拉尼亚城镇带来繁荣。

english: Te Anau is the largest lake of New Zealand’s South Island. Three deep western arms form inland fiords, while the lake’s great depth places much of its bed below sea level.
simp_chinese: 蒂阿瑙是新西兰南岛最大的湖泊。西侧三条深长支湾构成内陆峡湾，湖水极深，使大片湖底低于海平面。

english: These remote Pacific waters lie around the volcanic Marquesas archipelago. Voyagers from western Polynesia reached the islands around the tenth century, establishing communities far from any continental shore.
simp_chinese: 这片遥远的太平洋水域环绕着火山成因的马克萨斯群岛。来自西波利尼西亚的航海者大约在十世纪抵达这里，在远离大陆海岸的岛屿上建立了社群。

english: These waters surround the volcanic Marquesas Islands. The wider archipelago, whose local name means Land of Men, was settled around the tenth century by voyagers from western Polynesia.
simp_chinese: 这片水域环绕火山岛组成的马克萨斯群岛。更广阔的群岛在当地名称中意为人之地，约于十世纪由来自波利尼西亚西部的航海者定居。

english: These waters belong to the wider Polynesian setting around Aono Raina. The Line Islands form a volcanic chain of atolls and coral islands extending for more than two thousand kilometres across the central Pacific.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于阿奥诺赖纳周边广义的波利尼西亚地区。莱恩群岛形成一条火山起源的环礁与珊瑚岛链，在中太平洋延伸超过两千公里。

english: These high seas take their name from the Marquesas, Te Henua Enana, the land of men. The wider volcanic archipelago lies far northeast of Tahiti. Archaeology places its settlement by voyagers from western Polynesia in the tenth century, long before Mendaña's visit in 1595.
simp_chinese: 这片远海以马克萨斯群岛得名，其本地名称Te Henua Enana意为人之地。更广阔的火山群岛位于塔希提遥远的东北方。考古研究认为，来自西波利尼西亚的航海者于十世纪定居，远早于1595年门达尼亚的来访。

english: These waters surround the volcanic Marquesas, whose Indigenous name Te Henua Enana means “the land of men”. Voyagers from western Polynesia settled the islands around the tenth century, and Álvaro de Mendaña visited them in 1595.
simp_chinese: 这片海域环绕火山形成的马克萨斯群岛，其原住民名称Te Henua Enana意为“人的土地”。西波利尼西亚航海者约于十世纪在岛上定居，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚则于1595年到访。

english: These waters surround the volcanic Marquesas, whose local name Te Henua Enana means the land of men. Voyagers from western Polynesia settled the wider group in the tenth century; Mendaña visited in 1595 and gave the islands their European name.
simp_chinese: 这片海域环绕火山形成的马克萨斯群岛，其本地名称意为人之地。西波利尼西亚航海者于10世纪定居更广阔群岛；门达尼亚于1595年来访，赋予其欧洲名称。

english: These seas surround the broader Marquesas, volcanic islands whose Indigenous name Te Henua Enana means “the land of men”. Voyagers from western Polynesia settled the group around the tenth century, reaching one of the Pacific’s most isolated archipelagos.
simp_chinese: 这片海域环绕更广阔的马克萨斯火山群岛，其原住民名称Te Henua Enana意为“人的土地”。来自西波利尼西亚的航海者约在十世纪抵达并定居于这个太平洋最偏远的群岛之一。

english: These open seas surround the Marquesas, the volcanic islands called Te Henua Enana, Land of Men. Voyagers from western Polynesia settled the wider archipelago around the tenth century, long before Alvaro de Mendana visited in 1595.
simp_chinese: 这片远海围绕火山构成的马克萨斯群岛，其本土名称Te Henua Enana意为“人的土地”。约10世纪，来自西波利尼西亚的航海者定居群岛，远早于1595年门达尼亚的来访。

english: Te Tai Aorere belongs to New Zealand’s South Island. The wider island country was among the last large habitable lands settled by people, with Polynesian settlement beginning between about 1280 and 1350.
simp_chinese: 泰泰奥雷雷属于新西兰南岛。新西兰是人类最后定居的大片宜居陆地之一，波利尼西亚人大约在1280至1350年间开始定居。

english: Te Tai-o-Aorere lies near the northern end of New Zealand’s South Island. Separation Point divides its waters from neighbouring Golden Bay to the northwest.
simp_chinese: 泰塔伊奥奥雷雷湾位于新西兰南岛北端附近。分离角将其与西北方邻接的金湾水域分隔开来。

english: Te Tairāwhiti belongs to the eastern country of New Zealand’s North Island. In the wider archipelago, Polynesian settlement arrived in several waves of ocean-going waka, establishing the communities from which Māori culture developed.
simp_chinese: 泰拉维提属于新西兰北岛东部。在更广阔的群岛，波利尼西亚人分数批乘远洋独木舟抵达，建立了后来发展为毛利文化的社群。

english: Te Ulu-o-Te-Watu belongs to the wide Polynesian island world. Across this central and southern Pacific region, more than a thousand scattered islands share related languages, cultural practices and traditional beliefs.
simp_chinese: 特乌鲁特瓦图属于广阔的波利尼西亚岛屿世界。在这片中南太平洋地区，千余座散布岛屿拥有相关语言、文化习俗与传统信仰。

english: These coastal waters lie within the wider Line Islands region. The chain includes Kiritimati, whose land area is the largest of any atoll, amid scattered coral islands in the central Pacific.
simp_chinese: 这片沿海水域位于更广阔的莱恩群岛地区。岛链包含基里蒂马蒂，其陆地面积为世界环礁之最，周围是散布于太平洋中部的珊瑚岛。

english: Teahuahu Bay belongs to the wider Polynesian island region. This Pacific world contains more than a thousand islands, with Indigenous cultures sharing many linguistic and customary connections.
simp_chinese: 泰阿胡阿胡湾属于波利尼西亚岛屿地区。这片太平洋地域拥有一千多座岛屿，原住民文化之间存在许多语言与习俗联系。

english: The Papakena island waters include Tureia, an atoll of the Tuamotu Archipelago. Its eastern reef is covered by a long island, the lagoon has no navigable entrance, and coconut cultivation occupies much of the usable land.
simp_chinese: 帕帕凯纳岛屿水域包括土阿莫土群岛的图雷亚环礁。东侧礁缘由一座长岛覆盖，潟湖没有可供船舶通行的入口，许多可用土地用于种植椰子。

english: Teayotlan belongs to the Tuxpan country of the Mexican Gulf coast. In the wider region, pre-Hispanic Tochpan was a Huastec commercial centre whose market drew merchants from the Valley of Mexico and Tulancingo.
simp_chinese: 特阿约特兰属于墨西哥湾沿岸的图斯潘地区。在更广阔的地区，西班牙征服前的托奇潘是瓦斯特克商业中心，其市场吸引墨西哥谷与图兰辛戈的商人。

english: Tebang belongs to the high grassland country of South Africa’s Free State. The wider region consists of broad plains broken by occasional hills, rising toward the Drakensberg and Maloti foothills in the east.
simp_chinese: 特邦属于南非自由邦的高地草原地区。广大地区由偶有山丘突起的辽阔平原组成，向东逐渐升向德拉肯斯堡与马洛蒂山麓。

english: Tebesjuak Lake lies in Nunavut’s Kivalliq country and is linked to the Kunwak River. Trout and whitefish inhabit its waters, while winter caribou hunting is sometimes practiced around its shores.
simp_chinese: 特贝斯朱阿克湖位于努纳武特基瓦利克地区，与昆瓦克河相连。水中生活着湖鳟与白鲑，湖岸周围有时进行冬季驯鹿狩猎。

english: Tébessa preserves the memory of Roman Theveste near the Tunisian frontier. Its surviving walls and gates accompany another local tradition, the making of Algerian carpets.
simp_chinese: 泰贝萨在突尼斯边境附近保留着罗马城市泰韦斯特的记忆。幸存城墙与城门之外，当地还有制作阿尔及利亚地毯的传统。

english: Tebourba occupies the site of Roman Thuburbo Minus near Tunis. The ancient settlement was established as a veterans’ colony in the first century BC.
simp_chinese: 泰布尔巴位于突尼斯城附近的罗马小图布尔博遗址上。古聚落在公元前1世纪建立为退伍军人殖民地。

english: Tecalco belongs to the wider Tepeaca country of Puebla. The regional centre’s name derives from Nahuatl words for hill and nose or projecting tip. During the Spanish conquest Hernan Cortes founded Segura de la Frontera there, while the surrounding district became associated with the extraction of onyx and marble.
simp_chinese: 特卡尔科属于普埃布拉的特佩亚卡地区。区域中心的名称来自纳瓦特尔语中表示山丘与鼻端或突出部分的词。西班牙征服期间，埃尔南·科尔特斯在当地建立塞古拉德拉弗龙特拉，周边地区也与缟玛瑙和大理石开采相联系。

english: Tecamachalco belongs to the Puebla country of central Mexico. Before the Spanish conquest, its population spoke Popoloca, while the local elite probably used Nahuatl, reflecting the overlapping linguistic communities and political connections of the region.
simp_chinese: 特卡马查尔科位于墨西哥中部的普埃布拉地区。西班牙征服前，居民使用波波洛卡语，而地方精英可能使用纳瓦特尔语，反映出区域内彼此交叠的语言社群与政治联系。

english: Techamutete, also called Chamutete, lies in the Huíla country of southern Angola. In the railway age it became the terminus of a branch from Dongo on the southern rail system.
simp_chinese: 特沙穆泰泰也称沙穆泰泰，位于安哥拉南部威拉地区。铁路时代，它成为南部铁路系统中从栋戈引出支线的终点。

english: Techiman is a centre of the Bono country in Ghana. Akan, Bono, Gonja and other communities share a landscape with two rainy seasons and a dry season.
simp_chinese: 特奇曼是加纳博诺地区的中心。阿肯、博诺、贡贾等社群共同生活于每年经历两个雨季与一个旱季的地区。

english: Tecka was a winter camp of Tehuelche communities in Patagonia. It later became an important Mapuche encampment. The surrounding modern countryside supports sheep raising, cattle pasture and ranches.
simp_chinese: 特卡曾是巴塔哥尼亚特韦尔切社群的冬营地，后来成为重要马普切营地。现代周边乡间支撑养羊、牧牛与牧场经营。

english: Tecklenburg grew around a castle in the western foothills of the Teutoburg Forest. Its county emerged in the twelfth century and later joined Bentheim. Prussia conquered the town in 1701, while the medieval streetscape survived much of the subsequent change.
simp_chinese: 特克伦堡围绕条顿堡森林西麓的城堡发展，伯国于十二世纪形成，后来与本特海姆合并。普鲁士于1701年征服城镇，中世纪街区格局则在后续变化中大体保留。

english: Tecoanapa lies in the Guerrero country of southern Mexico. The town serves as the seat of the surrounding municipality, preserving its name within the modern administrative landscape.
simp_chinese: 特科阿纳帕位于墨西哥南部格雷罗地区。城镇是周边同名市镇的治所，其名称在现代行政景观中延续。

english: Tecohtzincalpan belongs to the historical Cuzcatlan country of western El Salvador. Cuzcatlan was a Nahua confederation stretching between the Paz and Lempa rivers. Its language, temples and art reflected connections with both Maya and Toltec cultural worlds.
simp_chinese: 特科钦卡尔潘属于萨尔瓦多西部历史上的库斯卡坦地区。库斯卡坦是延伸于帕斯河与伦帕河之间的纳瓦人联盟。其语言、神庙和艺术反映出与玛雅及托尔特克文化世界的联系。

english: The waters off Tecopa Cape belong to the Gulf of California, separating the Baja California Peninsula from mainland Mexico. Complex plate tectonics have created depths exceeding three thousand metres, while the gulf supports exceptionally diverse marine life.
simp_chinese: 特科帕角外的水域属于加利福尼亚湾，将下加利福尼亚半岛与墨西哥大陆分开。复杂的板块运动形成了超过三千米的水深，海湾同时滋养着极为多样的海洋生物。

english: Tecozautla lies in Hidalgo in central-eastern Mexico and is also known in Otomi as Masofo. Its Nahuatl name is interpreted as the place where yellow earth abounds.
simp_chinese: 特科绍特拉位于墨西哥中东部伊达尔戈，奥托米语也称马索福。其纳瓦特尔语名称被解释为“黄土丰富之地”。

english: Tecpan lies in Guerrero in southern Mexico. The present city serves as the seat of its surrounding municipality and bears the name of Hermenegildo Galeana.
simp_chinese: 特克潘位于墨西哥南部格雷罗地区。今天的城市是周边同名市镇的行政中心，名称中也纪念着埃尔梅内希尔多·加莱亚纳。

english: Tecuci stands among wooded hills on the right bank of the Bârlad. Its later railways met here from Galați, Bârlad and Mărășești.
simp_chinese: 泰库奇位于林木覆盖的丘陵间、伯尔拉德河右岸。后来的铁路在此汇合，分别通向加拉茨、伯尔拉德与默勒谢什蒂。

english: Tede belongs to the wider Oyo country of Yorubaland. The Oyo Empire grew through trade, political organisation and the military use of cavalry. At its height it exercised influence over many Yoruba kingdoms and neighbouring Dahomey.
simp_chinese: 特德属于约鲁巴奥约的广大地域。奥约帝国凭借贸易、政治组织与骑兵军事力量发展，鼎盛时影响多个约鲁巴王国及邻近达荷美。

english: The Tedei occupied country between Shark Bay and the upper Wooramel valley. Linguistic research connects them with the Yingkarta rather than treating them as entirely separate. Their territory followed the river inland, linking coastal and interior environments.
simp_chinese: 特代人居住在鲨鱼湾与伍拉梅尔河上游谷地之间。语言研究将他们与因加尔塔人联系起来，并不完全视为独立群体。领土沿河伸向内陆，连接海岸与内部环境。

english: Dellys grew around a sheltered harbour east of the Sebaou on Algeria’s Mediterranean coast. Its Ottoman casbah overlooks a district sustained by fishing and farming, beneath the mountain of Assouaf.
simp_chinese: 代利斯围绕阿尔及利亚地中海岸塞巴乌河以东的避风港成长。奥斯曼城堡区俯瞰阿苏阿夫山下以渔业和农业为生的地区。

english: Tedim lies in the Chin hills of Myanmar. Oral tradition attributes its foundation around 1600 to Gui Mang II of the Guite family. Repeated abandonment and resettlement accompanied struggles among regional chiefly houses.
simp_chinese: 德丁位于缅甸钦山。口述传统将其约1600年的创建归于贵族古伊特家族的桂芒二世。区域酋长家族斗争伴随着聚落反复被弃与重建。

english: Tednest belongs to Morocco’s Haha country. The broader Maghreb connects Atlantic and Mediterranean lands with the Sahara, within a North African region long inhabited by Berber peoples.
simp_chinese: 泰德内斯特属于摩洛哥的哈哈地区。更广阔的马格里布将大西洋与地中海地区同撒哈拉相连，是柏柏尔人长期居住的北非区域。

english: Tedote belongs to the Canary Islands off northwestern Africa. This Atlantic archipelago includes La Palma, Tenerife and several other major islands, and was historically known as the Fortunate Isles.
simp_chinese: 特多特属于非洲西北岸外的加那利群岛。这片大西洋群岛包括拉帕尔马、特内里费及其他主要岛屿，历史上曾被称为幸运群岛。

english: Teel lies in the wider Zavkhan region of western Mongolia. The region is named for the Zavkhan River and is centred on Uliastai.
simp_chinese: 特勒位于蒙古西部更广阔的扎布汗地区。地区因扎布汗河得名，以乌里雅苏台为中心。

english: Teem belongs to the broad Patagonian region at the southern end of South America. Patagonia combines the southern Andes, western fjords and glaciers with deserts, tablelands and steppes farther east.
simp_chinese: 特姆属于南美洲南端广阔的巴塔哥尼亚地区。巴塔哥尼亚包括南安第斯山脉、西部峡湾与冰川，以及更东面的荒漠、台地和草原。

english: Teewinot rises as a sharp monolith in Wyoming's Teton range. Its name refers to pinnacles, while successive glaciers helped carve the exposed summit spires and steep surrounding faces.
simp_chinese: 蒂维诺特以尖锐独岩的形态耸立在怀俄明提顿山脉。名称意指尖峰，反复冰川作用雕刻出裸露峰尖与周围陡峭岩壁。

english: Tefelfelt belongs to the wider Fez country of Morocco. Fez stands in the Saïs plain and became a major center of trade, leatherworking and Islamic learning.
simp_chinese: 特费尔费尔特属于摩洛哥更广阔的非斯地域。非斯坐落在萨伊斯平原，发展为贸易、制革与伊斯兰学术的重要中心。

english: Tefeyak belongs to the wider Enlhet country of the Paraguayan Chaco. Enlhet, also called Northern Lengua, is the language of the northern Enxet communities.
simp_chinese: 特费亚克属于巴拉圭查科更广阔的恩尔赫特人地区。恩尔赫特语也称北伦瓜语，是北部恩克塞特社群的语言。

english: Tegal occupies the northern coast of central Java. The city belongs to the pesisir coastal belt, with Brebes to the west and the wider Tegal countryside to the south and east.
simp_chinese: 直葛位于爪哇中部北海岸。城市属于北岸滨海地带，西邻布雷贝斯，南面与东面则连接更广阔的直葛乡村地区。

english: Tegeget belongs to Tamasna, the Moroccan region between the Bou Regreg and Tensift rivers. The wider region’s history includes the Barghwata, later Bedouin settlements and the military influence of Zenata and Hawwara confederations under the Marinids.
simp_chinese: 特格格特属于摩洛哥布雷格雷格河与坦西夫特河之间的塔马斯纳地区。广义地区历史包括巴格瓦塔人、后来的贝都因定居，以及马林王朝时期泽纳塔与哈瓦拉联盟的军事影响。

english: Tegelspit belongs to the wider Vitim basin. The river begins east of Baikal and crosses the Stanovoy Highlands toward the Lena. Maksim Perfilyev explored it in 1639–40, bringing back reports of country toward the upper Amur.
simp_chinese: 特格尔施皮特属于广大的维季姆流域。河流始于贝加尔湖以东，穿过斯塔诺夫高地通往勒拿河。马克西姆佩尔菲利耶夫于1639至1640年勘察河道，带回了通向上阿穆尔地域的消息。

english: Tegen is a small rural locality in the Olyokminsk region of Sakha. It belongs to the Kyachchi rural area and lies far from the district’s main town.
simp_chinese: 特根是萨哈奥廖克明斯克地区的小型乡村聚落。它属于克亚奇乡村区域，与该区主要城镇相距较远。

english: Tegina is a town in Nigeria’s Niger State within the Rafi country. Several Kainji languages are spoken in and around the settlement, reflecting the linguistic variety of this West African interior.
simp_chinese: 泰吉纳是尼日利亚尼日尔州拉菲地区的一座城镇。聚落及周边使用数种卡因吉语言，体现了这一西非内陆地区的语言多样性。

english: Tenginateo belongs to the Virginia region of eastern North America. Across this wider landscape, the Atlantic Plain gives way inland to the Piedmont and Blue Ridge, with human presence extending back to hunter-gatherers about 17,000 years ago.
simp_chinese: 特格尼纳托属于北美洲东部的弗吉尼亚地区。从更大的地域看，大西洋沿岸平原向内陆过渡为皮德蒙特和蓝岭山地，人类活动可追溯至约17000年前的狩猎采集者。

english: Teguise belongs to the Canary archipelago, an Atlantic island group off northwestern Africa. Long known as the Fortunate Isles, these islands occupy a strategic position between Africa, Europe and the Americas.
simp_chinese: 特吉塞属于非洲西北海岸外大西洋中的加那利群岛。这些岛屿古称幸运群岛，处在非洲、欧洲与美洲之间的重要位置。

english: Tegyulte is a small rural settlement in Russia’s Sakha Republic. Its extreme subarctic climate has produced recorded temperatures spanning more than 100 degrees Celsius between the coldest and hottest observations.
simp_chinese: 特古尔特是俄罗斯萨哈共和国的一座小型乡村聚落。当地气候极为寒冷，历史最低与最高气温记录之间的跨度超过摄氏100度。

english: The coast around Muscat faces the Gulf of Oman. These waters connect the Arabian Sea with Hormuz and the Persian Gulf, between Oman’s shore and the coasts of Iran and Pakistan.
simp_chinese: 马斯喀特周边海岸面向阿曼湾。这些水域在阿曼与伊朗、巴基斯坦海岸之间，连接阿拉伯海、霍尔木兹海峡及波斯湾。

english: Tehaolei is an inhabited island within the Sikaiana coral atoll in the Solomon Islands. It occupies the northwestern end of the atoll, alongside the other islands Sikaiana, Matuiloto and Matuavi.
simp_chinese: 特豪莱是所罗门群岛锡凯阿纳珊瑚环礁中的一座有人居住岛屿。它位于环礁西北端，与锡凯阿纳、马图伊洛托及马图阿维诸岛同属这一环礁。

english: The Tehaolei coastal waters belong to the Solomon Islands’ Melanesian archipelago. The wider island region was inhabited long before European contact, with later Lapita migrants joining earlier communities; the Spanish navigator Mendaña reached the islands in 1568.
simp_chinese: 特哈奥莱伊沿海水域属于所罗门群岛的美拉尼西亚群岛区域。早在欧洲人到来之前，当地已有悠久定居历史，后来的拉皮塔移民加入早期社群；西班牙航海者门达尼亚于1568年抵达群岛。

english: The Tehaolei waters belong to the Solomon island region of Melanesia. Large islands and many smaller neighbours form a broad maritime archipelago northeast of Australia.
simp_chinese: 特豪莱伊水域属于美拉尼西亚的所罗门群岛地区。大型岛屿与众多较小邻岛，在澳大利亚东北方构成广阔的海洋群岛。

english: These waters belong to the wider maritime setting of the Solomon Islands northeast of Australia. The archipelago contains large Melanesian islands as well as numerous smaller islands, with Bougainville adjoining the modern country to the west.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于澳大利亚东北方所罗门群岛广阔的海洋地理环境。群岛既有美拉尼西亚的大岛，也有众多小岛，布干维尔岛位于现代所罗门群岛国以西。

english: These offshore waters lie in the Solomon Islands region of Melanesia. The islands northeast of Australia were settled through successive migration waves, including the seafaring Lapita people.
simp_chinese: 这片外海位于美拉尼西亚的所罗门群岛地区。澳大利亚东北方的这些岛屿经历多次移民浪潮，包括善于航海的拉皮塔人。

english: These waters belong to the Solomon island seas of Melanesia. The archipelago contains major islands and more than a thousand smaller ones, with a settlement history including Lapita migration long before Mendaña’s European voyage of 1568.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于美拉尼西亚的所罗门岛屿海域。群岛包括主要大岛及一千多座小岛，定居史中有拉皮塔移民，其年代远早于门达尼亚1568年的欧洲航行。

english: Tehcha belongs to the lower Zeya country of the middle Amur. The Amur basin forms part of Manchuria in the term’s wider historical sense; parts of this broad borderland passed from Qing rule to the Russian Empire in 1858–1860.
simp_chinese: 特查属于中阿穆尔地区的下结雅河一带。广义的历史满洲包含阿穆尔流域；这片广大边疆的部分土地在1858至1860年间从清朝统治下转入俄罗斯帝国。

english: Tehek Lake belongs to the northern Keewatin landscape west of Hudson Bay. The wider district’s name derives from the Cree and Ojibwe words for “north wind.” Later Canadian administration retained Keewatin as a northern district after its southern lands were transferred to the provinces in 1912.
simp_chinese: 特赫克湖属于哈得孙湾以西的北基韦廷地貌区。更广阔地区的名称源自克里语和奥吉布瓦语中的“北风”。1912年南部土地划入各省后，加拿大行政体系仍将北部保留为基韦廷区。

english: Teotihuacan rose in the Valley of Mexico many centuries before the Aztec Empire. Its monumental landscape includes the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, and at its height it was the largest city in the Americas.
simp_chinese: 特奥蒂瓦坎在阿兹特克帝国出现之前数百年便兴起于墨西哥谷。宏伟遗迹包括太阳金字塔与月亮金字塔，鼎盛时它是美洲最大的城市。

english: Tehri, later known as Tikamgarh, began as three hamlets arranged roughly in a triangle. In the late eighteenth century the rulers of Orchha transferred their capital here, and the town took the name of its fort.
simp_chinese: 代赫里后来称为蒂卡姆加尔，最初由大致呈三角形分布的三个村落组成。18世纪末，奥尔恰统治者将都城迁来，此地随后以城堡之名命名。

english: Tehua belongs to the wider Suma country of northern Chihuahua and the El Paso region. Suma communities were semi-nomadic hunter-gatherers with little or no agriculture. Their closely related bands acted independently, rather than forming one united political body.
simp_chinese: 特瓦属于奇瓦瓦北部与埃尔帕索周边更广阔的苏马地区。苏马社群以半游动的狩猎采集生活为主，农业很少或没有。彼此关系密切的各支群体独立行事，并未形成统一政体。

english: Tehuacán lies in southeastern Puebla and takes its Nahuatl name from the place of the gods. Originally a Nahua settlement, it submitted to Hernán Cortés in 1520.
simp_chinese: 特瓦坎位于普埃布拉东南，纳瓦特尔语地名意为众神之地。它原为纳瓦人聚落，1520年向埃尔南·科尔特斯归顺。

english: Tehuantepec lay on a pre-Hispanic trade route between Central America and central Mexico. It later became a secondary capital of the Zapotec realm and remains a centre of Zapotec culture on the isthmus.
simp_chinese: 特万特佩克处于前西班牙时代连接中美洲与墨西哥中部的商路上。它后来成为萨波特克统治区的次要都城，至今仍是地峡地区的萨波特克文化中心。

english: The Pacific approaches to southern Mexico face the Mesoamerican cultural world. Indigenous societies developed here for millennia before the Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 墨西哥南部的太平洋外围面向中美洲文化世界。西班牙征服以前，原住民社会已在当地发展数千年。

english: Teiehonwahkhkwatha belongs to the historical Haudenosaunee setting. The confederacy’s name means those who build the longhouse, and its original five nations extended from the Mohawk in the east to the Seneca in the west.
simp_chinese: 泰耶洪瓦赫夸塔属于历史上的豪德诺索尼地区。联盟名称意为“建造长屋的人”，其最初五族从东部莫霍克延伸至西部塞内卡。

english: Tionontatatie belongs to the Mohawk Valley homeland of the Kanien'kehá꞉ka. The Mohawk were the easternmost original nation of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, known as the Keepers of the Eastern Door.
simp_chinese: 提奥农塔塔提属于卡尼恩凯哈卡人的莫霍克河谷故土。莫霍克人是霍迪诺肖尼联盟最初成员中最东的一族，被称为东门守护者。

english: Tejend belongs to the broad historical landscape of Khorasan. This eastern Iranian and Central Asian region had shifting boundaries, and wider uses of the name extended toward the Caspian coast and the Pamirs.
simp_chinese: 捷詹属于广阔的呼罗珊历史区域。这个横跨伊朗东部与中亚的地区边界时有变化，广义的名称范围可延伸至里海沿岸与帕米尔。

english: Tekabket belongs to the Talas river country of Central Asia. The wider river crosses from the Kyrgyz mountains into Kazakhstan and disappears in the Muyunkum Desert, while its valley gave its name to the Abbasid-Tang battle of 751.
simp_chinese: 特卡布凯特属于中亚的怛罗斯河地区。更广阔的河流由吉尔吉斯山地进入哈萨克斯坦，消失于莫因库姆沙漠，河谷也为751年阿拔斯与唐军的战役赋名。

english: Tekahionhake belongs to the wider Southwestern Ontario country. The region occupies much of the Ontario Peninsula between Lake Huron, Lake Erie and the waterways facing Lower Michigan.
simp_chinese: 特卡希翁哈克属于更广阔的安大略西南地区。这片地域占据安大略半岛的大部分，处在休伦湖、伊利湖与面向密歇根下半岛的水道之间。

english: Takapō, commonly written Tekapo, lies along the northern edge of New Zealand’s Mackenzie Basin. It forms one of three roughly parallel lakes with Pukaki and Ōhau.
simp_chinese: 塔卡波通常写作特卡波，位于新西兰麦肯齐盆地北缘。它与普卡基湖、奥豪湖共同构成三座大致平行的湖泊。

english: Teke is a shallow salt lake in northern Kazakhstan’s Ishim Plain. Snow and groundwater feed its closed basin, surrounded by salt flats and saline soils; salt is extracted along its shores, while migrating cranes gather on the western bank.
simp_chinese: teke是哈萨克斯坦北部伊希姆平原上的浅咸水湖。积雪与地下水补给着封闭湖盆，周边是盐滩与盐渍土；湖岸可采盐，迁徙鹤群则在西岸聚集。

english: The Teke Peninsula projects between the gulfs of Antalya and Fethiye. Known in antiquity as Lycia, it preserves cities including Myra, Xanthos and Patara. Its later name recalls a Turkmen tribe settled during the Sultanate of Rum.
simp_chinese: 泰凯半岛伸出于安塔利亚与费特希耶两湾之间。古称利基亚，保存着米拉、克桑托斯与帕塔拉等城址。后来的名称纪念鲁姆苏丹国时期定居的土库曼部落。

english: Tekeli belongs to the wider Jetisu region of Central Asia. Also known as Semirechye, this historical country corresponds largely to the southeastern part of modern Kazakhstan.
simp_chinese: 铁克利属于中亚更广阔的七河地区。这里也称塞米列奇耶，这一历史地域大体对应现代哈萨克斯坦东南部。

english: Tekman lies in the Erzurum highlands of eastern Anatolia. The Bingöl Mountains enclose its southern approaches, while numerous villages form the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 泰克曼位于安纳托利亚东部的埃尔祖鲁姆高地。宾格尔山脉环护南部通道，众多村落构成周围地区。

english: Tekouch belongs to the northeastern Algerian coastal region around Annaba. Annaba itself developed beside the ancient city of Hippo Regius and became an important seaport close to the Tunisian border.
simp_chinese: 特库什属于安纳巴周围的阿尔及利亚东北部沿海地区。安纳巴城本身在古代希波雷吉乌斯附近发展，成为靠近突尼斯边界的重要海港。

english: Tekro belongs to the wider Tibesti mountain country. Toubou communities adapted to its desert environment by using water held in gueltas and cultivating rare oases along the wadis.
simp_chinese: 特克罗属于更广阔的提贝斯提高山地区。图布人利用岩池中的积水，在干谷沿线稀少的绿洲耕作，适应当地沙漠环境。

english: Telantunich belongs to the Maya world of the Yucatan region. Across that wider civilization, maize, beans, squash and chilli supported settled communities. Maya scribes developed the most elaborate writing system of the pre-Columbian Americas, alongside sophisticated calendars and astronomical knowledge.
simp_chinese: 特兰图尼奇属于尤卡坦地区的玛雅世界。就整个文明而言，玉米、豆类、南瓜和辣椒支撑了定居社群。玛雅书吏发展出前哥伦布时代美洲最复杂的文字体系，并拥有精密的历法与天文知识。

english: Telavi stands below the Tsiv-Gombori range in Georgia’s Kakheti. Bronze Age finds precede the town’s emergence as an important political and administrative center in the eighth century.
simp_chinese: 泰拉维坐落在格鲁吉亚卡赫季的齐夫—贡博里山脉下方。当地青铜时代遗物，早于城镇在8世纪成为重要政治与行政中心。

english: Tele-Nugar is an iron-mining site south of Melfi in Chad. Fanian miners extracted and smelted iron here, leaving underground workings with ventilation holes and supporting pillars carved from the rock.
simp_chinese: 泰莱努加尔是乍得梅尔菲以南的一处铁矿遗址。法尼安人在此采矿冶铁，留下带通风孔的地下矿道，以及从岩壁中雕出的支撑石柱。

english: Telemba lies beside its namesake lake in Buryatia. The Konda River flows east and southeast of the village, which stands far east of the district centre at Sosnovo-Ozerskoye.
simp_chinese: 捷连巴位于布里亚特同名湖泊旁。孔达河从村庄东侧和东南侧流过，该村位于县城索斯诺沃-奥焦尔斯科耶以东较远处。

english: Telen belongs to the upper Mahakam country of Borneo. The wider river flows from the island’s highlands toward the Makassar Strait, passing through an extensive lake region downstream.
simp_chinese: 特伦属于婆罗洲的马哈坎河上游地区。更广的河流从岛内高地流向望加锡海峡，下游经过广阔湖区。

english: Teletskoye is the largest lake of the Altai Mountains, enclosed by steep mountain ridges. Its clear waters reach depths of about 325 meters, with the Chulyshman its principal incoming river.
simp_chinese: 捷列茨科耶湖是阿尔泰山最大湖泊，周围高峻山脊环抱。清澈湖水深达约325米，丘雷什曼河是主要入湖河流。

english: Telha was the earlier name of the Iguatu region in Ceará, taken from a large nearby lagoon. A Quixelô Indigenous village occupied the area before Jesuits arrived from 1707 onward.
simp_chinese: 特利亚是塞阿拉伊瓜图地区的旧称，取自附近一座大潟湖。自1707年起耶稣会士到来之前，当地已有基谢洛原住民村落。

english: Teliagarhi guarded a pass into Bengal from northern India. Bakhtiyar Khilji used this approach during his conquest, and later Mughal and Afghan armies contested the fortress and nearby routes.
simp_chinese: 泰利亚加尔希守卫着印度北部通向孟加拉的山口。巴赫蒂亚尔·卡尔吉征服孟加拉时经由此路，后来莫卧儿与阿富汗军队又争夺堡垒及邻近通道。

english: Teligol belongs to the wider Yedisan country north of the Black Sea. This historical region lay between the Dniester and Southern Bug and later took its name from a Nogai horde.
simp_chinese: 泰利戈尔属于黑海以北更广阔的叶迪桑地区。这一历史地域位于德涅斯特河与南布格河之间，后来因一个诺盖部落联盟而得名。

english: The Tell Atlas stretches across northern Algeria towards Morocco and Tunisia. Its mountain barrier separates the Mediterranean coastlands from the Sahara, with Lalla Khedidja its highest summit.
simp_chinese: 泰勒阿特拉斯山脉横跨阿尔及利亚北部，延伸向摩洛哥和突尼斯。山地屏障分隔地中海沿岸与撒哈拉，最高峰为拉拉赫迪贾。

english: Great Tellico stood where important Indigenous trails met in the Tennessee hills. It became a leading Overhill Cherokee town before the removals of the 1830s. A United States fur-trading factory operated here from 1795 to 1807.
simp_chinese: 大特利科位于田纳西丘陵原住民重要道路交汇处，在1830年代迁徙之前是重要山外切罗基城镇。美国于1795至1807年在此经营毛皮贸易站。

english: Telmen lies in western Mongolia’s Zavkhan country. Its district had fewer than three thousand inhabitants in 2005.
simp_chinese: 特勒敏位于蒙古西部扎布汗地区。2005年，当地行政区人口不足3000。

english: Teloloapan was a large Chontal town before the Spanish conquest. Its ruler bore the title tletecutli and fought the Purépecha Empire, while sixteenth-century accounts record a separate language called Ixcuca in one quarter.
simp_chinese: 特洛洛阿潘在西班牙征服前是一座大型琼塔尔城镇。统治者称特莱特库特利，曾与普雷佩查帝国交战，16世纪记述还在一街区记录了称为伊什库卡的独立语言。

english: Teltow was first recorded in a Brandenburg deed of 1265. Named after the surrounding plateau, the town is also associated with the small regional turnips known as Teltower Rübchen.
simp_chinese: 泰尔托于1265年的勃兰登堡文书中首次见于记载。城名源自周围高原，也与当地著名的小型芜菁品种相联系。

english: Teluk Melano belongs to the coastal country associated with Sukadana in western Borneo. The wider region was linked to the Malay kingdom of Tanjungpura, whose former capital Sukadana was known to European writers for its port.
simp_chinese: 梅拉诺湾属于婆罗洲西部与苏卡达纳相联系的沿海地区。更广阔的区域与马来丹戎布拉王国相关，其旧都苏卡达纳以港口为欧洲记述者所知。

english: Temagami centres on its namesake lake in northeastern Ontario. Known as n’Daki Menan, the homeland of local Anishinaabe communities includes Bear Island and traditional family hunting and trapping territories.
simp_chinese: 特马加米以安大略东北部的同名湖泊为中心。当地阿尼希纳贝人的家园称为n’Daki Menan，包括熊岛及传统家族狩猎、设陷阱的领地。

english: Temascaltepec’s earlier inhabitants included Nahua, Matlatzinca and Mazahua communities. The settlement may originally have depended on neighbouring Texcaltitlán before the expansion of Aztec power.
simp_chinese: 特马斯卡尔特佩克的早期居民包括纳瓦、马特拉钦卡与马萨瓦社群。在阿兹特克势力扩张之前，聚落可能曾依附于邻近特斯卡尔蒂特兰。

english: Temasek was an early name for settlement on the site of modern Singapore. Malay, Javanese and Chinese records preserve the name, while accounts distinguish the harbor communities of Long Ya Men and Ban Zu.
simp_chinese: 淡马锡是今新加坡所在地聚落的早期名称。马来、爪哇与中国记载都保存了此名，史料还区分龙牙门与班卒两处港口社群。

english: Tematagi is an atoll in the southeastern Tuamotu Archipelago. Its reef completely encloses a deep lagoon with no navigable pass.
simp_chinese: 特马塔吉是土阿莫土群岛东南部的一座环礁。珊瑚礁完全围住深潟湖，没有可通航的缺口。

english: Tematagi’s waters belong to the coral-atoll region around Tureia in the southeastern Tuamotus. Tureia itself has a narrow land rim and a lagoon with no navigable opening through the reef.
simp_chinese: 特马塔吉水域属于图阿莫图东南部图雷亚附近的珊瑚环礁地区。图雷亚本身陆缘狭窄，潟湖没有穿过珊瑚礁的可通航开口。

english: Tembesha lies in the historical Bazin country of northeastern Africa. Medieval accounts described Bazin as one of several Beja polities between the Nile and the Red Sea region, with Kunama communities forming an important part of its population.
simp_chinese: 滕贝沙位于非洲东北部历史上的巴津地区。中世纪记载将巴津列为尼罗河至红海地区之间的贝贾诸政体之一，库纳马社群构成了当地人口的重要部分。

english: Tembesi belongs to the river country of Jambi in central Sumatra. The Tembesi receives the Merangin and joins the Batang Hari, draining a humid tropical landscape with abundant rainfall through the island’s eastern river system.
simp_chinese: 登贝西属于苏门答腊中部占碑的河流地区。登贝西河接纳墨朗吟河后汇入巴塘哈里河，通过岛屿东部水系排泄这片雨量充沛的湿润热带土地。

english: Tembue belongs to the wider Zumbo country on the middle Zambezi. At nearby Zumbo the Luangwa joins the Zambezi, creating a major river junction. A Portuguese trading post founded there in the early eighteenth century connected routes into Zimbabwe and toward Lake Bangweulu.
simp_chinese: 滕布埃属于赞比西河中游广义的宗博地区。宗博附近卢安瓜河汇入赞比西河，形成重要河流交汇处。十八世纪初在那里建立的葡萄牙商站，连接着通往津巴布韦与班韦乌卢湖方向的贸易路线。

english: Temir is a town in western Kazakhstan’s Aktobe region. It serves as the administrative centre of the surrounding Temir district.
simp_chinese: 捷米尔是哈萨克斯坦西部阿克托别地区的一座城镇，也是周围捷米尔区的行政中心。

english: Temir Baba belongs to the wider Mangystau country of western Kazakhstan. The region includes the desert Mangyshlak Peninsula beside the Caspian Sea, with the settlement of Mangistau east of Aktau.
simp_chinese: 铁米尔巴巴属于哈萨克斯坦西部更广阔的曼吉斯套地区。这里包括里海旁的荒漠曼格什拉克半岛，曼吉斯套聚落位于阿克套以东。

english: Temirkhan Shura stands on the Shura-Ozen River at the foot of the Greater Caucasus in Dagestan. Its name recalls a tradition that Timur camped here after defeating Tokhtamysh; later a small town ruled by a bek, it became a major Russian military center in the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 铁木尔汗舒拉坐落在达吉斯坦大高加索山麓的舒拉奥津河畔。其名称联系着帖木儿击败脱脱迷失后在此扎营的传说；这里后来是贝伊统治的小镇，19世纪成为俄罗斯的重要军事中心。

english: Temirlik belongs to the Qaidam Basin of the northeastern Tibetan Plateau. Across the wider basin, extreme aridity produces extensive saline lakes and playas, reflected in a Tibetan name meaning salt marsh.
simp_chinese: 铁木里克属于青藏高原东北部的柴达木盆地。在更广阔的盆地内，极端干旱形成大片咸水湖与干盐湖，其藏语名称即意为盐泽。

english: Témiscamie belongs to the forested Lake Mistassini basin of Quebec. Its river is one of the lake’s major tributaries. Spruce, birch, pine and fir surround Quebec’s largest natural lake, whose Indigenous name refers to a great rock near its outlet.
simp_chinese: 泰米斯卡米属于魁北克森林覆盖的米斯塔西尼湖流域，同名河流是湖泊主要支流之一。云杉、桦树、松树与冷杉环绕这座魁北克最大天然湖，原住民湖名指向出口附近的大石。

english: Témiscamingue belongs to the western Quebec lake country adjoining Ontario. Ville-Marie serves as its modern regional centre. Later roads reveal the importance of the provincial boundary: travel to the neighbouring district in the south can be shorter by crossing into Ontario and returning.
simp_chinese: 泰米斯卡明属于魁北克西部、毗邻安大略的湖区，现代地区中心为玛丽城。后来的道路显示省界的重要性：前往南部邻区时，越界进入安大略再返回，有时反而更近。

english: Témiscouata is a lake-centred region southeast of Rivière-du-Loup in Quebec. It borders New Brunswick, and the wider area's economy includes forestry, agriculture and maple products.
simp_chinese: 泰米斯瓜塔是魁北克里维耶尔迪卢东南的一片以湖泊为中心的地区。这里与新不伦瑞克相接，周边经济包括林业、农业和枫树制品。

english: Temnikov was established in 1536 in the Mordovian country. It received formal town status in 1779. The modern settlement remains the centre of its surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 捷姆尼科夫于1536年在莫尔多瓦地区建立，1779年取得正式城市地位。现代聚落仍是周围行政区的中心。

english: Temoe is a small atoll southeast of the Gambier Islands. Its low islets and lagoon are enclosed by a nearly continuous reef crossed by shallow spillways.
simp_chinese: 特莫埃是甘比尔群岛东南的一座小环礁。低矮岛屿与潟湖被近乎连续的礁环围绕，浅水口穿过礁体。

english: The Temotu High Sea lies in the southwestern Pacific region of Melanesia. The broader island world runs from New Guinea to Fiji, between Micronesia to the north and Australia to the south. Its modern regional name was introduced by the French navigator Dumont d’Urville in 1832.
simp_chinese: 泰莫图远海位于太平洋西南部的美拉尼西亚。广阔群岛世界从新几内亚延伸至斐济，北邻密克罗尼西亚，南近澳大利亚。今日地区名称由法国航海家迪蒙·迪尔维尔于1832年提出。

english: The Temotu High Sea belongs to the waters of the southeastern Solomon island world. At the broader Melanesian scale, island chains stretch from New Guinea towards Fiji, with the Solomons forming part of this southwestern Pacific region.
simp_chinese: 泰莫图远海属于所罗门群岛东南部海域。从更广的美拉尼西亚尺度看，岛链自新几内亚向斐济延展，所罗门群岛构成这片西南太平洋区域的一部分。

english: Tempio Pausania serves the Gallura country of northern Sardinia. Granite architecture in its old centre closely resembles towns of southern Corsica, reflecting the related built landscapes across the strait.
simp_chinese: 坦皮奥保萨尼亚是撒丁岛北部加卢拉地区的一处中心。旧城区花岗岩建筑与科西嘉南部城镇十分相似，展现了海峡两侧相关的建筑景观。

english: Templin lies in the southern Uckermark north of the Schorfheide forests. It first appears in a document issued by the bishop of Brandenburg in 1270.
simp_chinese: 滕普林位于乌克马克南部、绍尔夫海德森林以北。它最早见于勃兰登堡主教1270年颁发的一份文书。

english: Temryuk Bay opens north of the Taman Peninsula in the Sea of Azov. The Kuban enters its southern waters, and shallow depths make it an important fishing ground that can freeze during winter.
simp_chinese: 捷姆留克湾位于塔曼半岛以北的亚速海。库班河注入南部水域，浅水使这里成为重要渔场，冬季还可能结冰。

english: Temsamane is a community of Morocco’s Driouch country. Its modern commune counted about twelve thousand inhabitants in 2024.
simp_chinese: 泰姆萨曼是摩洛哥德里乌什地区的一处社群。2024年，现代市镇约有1.2万居民。

english: The Xalisco coast forms part of the Pacific margin of Mesoamerica. The region's Indigenous societies developed agriculture, cities and writing long before Spanish colonization.
simp_chinese: 哈利斯科海岸构成中部美洲文化区面向太平洋的边缘。当地原住民社会远在西班牙殖民之前就已发展农业、城市和文字。

english: Tenamaxtlán was founded in 1538 in Jalisco's Sierra de Amula country. Its name is associated with the three stones used to hold a cooking griddle above a fire in Mesoamerican households.
simp_chinese: 特纳马斯兰于1538年建立在哈利斯科的阿穆拉山地区。地名与中美洲家庭用来将烤盘架在火上的三块支撑石有关。

english: Tenamitl belongs to the Zinacantán country of the Chiapas highlands. In this wider Tzotzil Maya region, salt, amber and feathers entered trade with central Mexico before the Spanish conquest. The regional name means “place of bats,” recalling a bat cave revered by local inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 特纳米特尔属于恰帕斯高地的西纳坎坦地域。在这一广阔的措齐尔玛雅地区，西班牙征服前，盐、琥珀与羽毛已通过贸易流向墨西哥中部。地区名称意为“蝙蝠之地”，关联当地居民崇奉的蝙蝠洞。

english: Tenasserim occupies the narrow country north of the Kra Isthmus, facing the Andaman Sea. The wider region passed through the hands of Sukhothai, Ayutthaya and the Konbaung dynasty before being ceded to Britain after the First Anglo-Burmese War in 1826.
simp_chinese: 丹那沙林占据克拉地峡以北面向安达曼海的狭长地带。更广的地区先后受素可泰、阿瑜陀耶与贡榜王朝统治，1826年第一次英缅战争后被割让给英国。

english: The Tenawa were a division of the Comanche on the Southern Plains. They emerged as Yamparika groups moved southeast and joined the eastern Comanche.
simp_chinese: 特纳瓦是南部大平原科曼奇人的一个分支。亚姆帕里卡群体向东南迁移、加入东部科曼奇后，形成了这一分支。

english: Tencoa belongs to the Santa Bárbara country of Honduras. The wider department contains numerous inland communities around the town of Santa Bárbara. Historically its forests supplied mahogany and cedar for export, linking this interior district to wider commercial networks.
simp_chinese: 滕科阿属于洪都拉斯的圣巴巴拉地区。更广阔行政区包含圣巴巴拉城镇周围众多内陆社群。历史上森林出产桃花心木与雪松供出口，将这一内陆地区同更广泛的商业网络相连。

english: Tende belongs to the broader Kwanza-region landscape of Angola. The highlands between the Kwanza and Lukala rivers formed the heartland of Ndongo, a Kimbundu-speaking kingdom ruled by a king called the ngola.
simp_chinese: 滕德属于安哥拉宽扎地区的广大地域。宽扎与卢卡拉两河之间的高地曾是恩东戈核心地带，这是由称为恩戈拉的国王统治、使用金本杜语的王国。

english: Tendukheda belongs to the central Indian landscape of Gondwana. The region lies on the northern Deccan plateau and contains ancient rock formations that gave their name to the supercontinent Gondwanaland.
simp_chinese: 滕杜凯拉属于印度中部的贡德瓦纳地带。该地区位于德干高原北部，古老岩层曾为冈瓦纳古大陆提供名称。

english: Tendžiogala belongs to the Samogitian country around Raseiniai. The regional centre lies at the southeastern foothills of the Samogitian highland and was already recorded in 1253, later becoming an important town of Samogitia.
simp_chinese: 滕焦加拉属于拉塞尼艾周围的萨莫吉蒂亚地区。地区中心位于萨莫吉蒂亚高地东南山麓，1253年已有记载，后来成为当地重要城镇。

english: Ténenkou is a market settlement in Mali's Macina country. Its Thursday market draws people from many surrounding communities, giving the village a wider regional role.
simp_chinese: 泰嫩库是马里马西纳地区的一处集市聚落。周四集市吸引周围多个社群居民，使村庄承担着更广泛的区域作用。

english: The Ténéré spreads across the southern Sahara from northeastern Niger toward western Chad. Sand plains and the dunes of Bilma fill the country between the Aïr, Hoggar and Tibesti highlands.
simp_chinese: 泰内雷横跨撒哈拉南部，从尼日尔东北延向乍得西部。沙质平原与比尔马沙丘铺展于阿伊尔、阿哈加尔及提贝斯提高地之间。

english: Ténès began as a Phoenician port on Algeria’s coast. Under Carthaginian and Roman rule it was known as Cartenna and became a Roman colony. Vandal conquest and later changes of rule interrupted the old city before a medieval settlement developed again.
simp_chinese: 特内斯起源于阿尔及利亚海岸的腓尼基港口。迦太基与罗马统治时期，这里称卡尔滕纳，并成为罗马殖民城市。汪达尔征服及后来的政权更替打断古城生活，随后又出现中世纪聚落。

english: Tengapani belongs to the wider Sadiya country of the upper Brahmaputra region. Sadiya was a capital of the Chutia kingdom, and its surrounding plains stand beside the Lohit beneath forested Himalayan mountains.
simp_chinese: 滕加帕尼属于布拉马普特拉河上游更广阔的萨地亚地区。萨地亚曾是楚蒂亚王国都城，周围平原依偎洛希特河，背靠森林覆盖的喜马拉雅山。

english: Tengchen belongs to the Kham country of eastern Tibet. The wider region’s Khampa communities were historically organized around chiefs and monasteries, within mountain valleys and broad grasslands.
simp_chinese: 丁青属于西藏东部康区。广义地区的康巴社群历史上围绕首领与寺院组织，生活于山地河谷与开阔草原之间。

english: Tengchong lies in western Yunnan along the frontier with Myanmar. The region is known for volcanic activity, and the town was also historically called Tengyue.
simp_chinese: 腾冲位于云南西部、缅甸边境一带。当地以火山活动闻名，城镇历史上也称腾越。

english: Tengdong belongs to the Tengzhou country of southern Shandong. The area was the seat of the ancient state of Teng during the Spring and Autumn period and is traditionally associated with the philosopher Mozi.
simp_chinese: 滕东属于山东南部的滕州地区。春秋时期，这里是古滕国的所在地，并在传统中与思想家墨子相联系。

english: Tenggarong stands on the Mahakam's western bank in eastern Borneo. Formerly Tepian Pandan, it became the capital of the Kutai Kartanegara sultanate. A ruler renamed it Tangga Arung, House of the King, from which the present name developed.
simp_chinese: 登加龙位于婆罗洲东部马哈坎河西岸，旧称特皮安潘丹，曾是库台卡塔内加拉苏丹国首都。统治者将其改名唐加阿隆，意为国王之家，逐渐演变为现名。

english: The Tengger Desert spreads through Alasha and neighbouring Ningxia. Its Mongolian name means Sky Desert. Modern efforts to stabilize shifting sand have used straw barriers, saxaul planting and belts of trees along threatened margins.
simp_chinese: 腾格里沙漠延伸于阿拉善及邻近宁夏，蒙古语名称意为天空沙漠。现代固沙工程利用草方格、梭梭种植和防护林保护受威胁的边缘地带。

english: Tenggulang belongs to the lower Musi country of southeastern Sumatra. The wider Palembang region was governed by a sultanate whose territories formed the historical core of modern South Sumatra.
simp_chinese: 滕古朗属于苏门答腊东南的穆西河下游地区。广义巨港地区由苏丹国统治，其领土构成如今南苏门答腊的历史核心。

english: Tengiz stands within the broad historical Kipchak plains. Between the tenth and thirteenth centuries, Cumania was associated with a nomadic confederation led by Cumans and Kipchaks; its alternative names, Dasht-i Qipchaq and Polovtsian Steppe, preserve different traditions of describing the same steppe world.
simp_chinese: 田吉兹位于历史上的广义钦察平原。十至十三世纪，库曼尼亚与库曼和钦察人主导的游牧联盟相联系；达什特·钦察与波洛韦茨草原等名称，保留了不同文献传统对这片草原世界的称呼。

english: Tengiz is a shallow salt lake in the Kazakh Uplands. The Nura and Kulanotpes feed its seasonally changing waters. Its indented eastern shore includes islands, while neighbouring lakes form a larger wetland landscape.
simp_chinese: 田吉兹是哈萨克丘陵的一座浅咸水湖。努拉河与库拉诺特佩斯河补给季节性变化的湖水。曲折东岸分布岛屿，邻近湖泊共同构成更广阔的湿地景观。

english: Tengréla lies near the border between Côte d’Ivoire and Mali. René Caillié visited its walled settlement in 1828 with a large kola-nut caravan, while an old adobe mosque reflects the region’s Sudano-Sahelian building tradition.
simp_chinese: 滕格雷拉位于科特迪瓦与马里边界附近。勒内·卡耶于1828年随大型可乐果商队访问这座围墙聚落，古老土坯清真寺则体现了地区苏丹—萨赫勒建筑传统。

english: Tengxian, now Tengzhou, occupies the country of the ancient state of Teng in Shandong. The region is also associated with the philosopher Mozi, whose birthplace is often placed here.
simp_chinese: 滕县即今滕州，位于山东古代滕国所在地。这一地区也与哲学家墨子相关，其出生地常被认为在这里。

english: Teniky lies in the isolated Isalo massif of southwestern Madagascar. Rock-cut niches, terraces, walls and stone basins distinguish it from other island sites. Charcoal dates some structures to the tenth–twelfth centuries, while imported Chinese and Southeast Asian pottery reveals connections reaching well beyond the mountain interior.
simp_chinese: 特尼基位于马达加斯加西南孤立的伊萨卢山地。凿岩壁龛、台地、石墙和石盆，使其区别于岛上其他遗址。木炭测年将部分建筑定在十至十二世纪，中国及东南亚进口陶瓷则显示跨越山地内陆的远程联系。

english: The Shikoku coast lies beside an island divided into the four regions of Ehime, Kagawa, Kōchi and Tokushima. Its east–west mountain ranges separate the narrow northern shore facing the Seto Inland Sea from the southern Pacific side.
simp_chinese: 四国海岸位于分为爱媛、香川、高知和德岛四个地区的岛屿边缘。东西走向的山脉，将面向濑户内海的北部狭窄海岸与南部太平洋一侧分开。

english: Tenkasi means southern Kashi in Tamil. The name reflects the importance of the Viswanathar temple in this southern Indian town. Its religious identity links the local Pandya country with a wider sacred geography centred on the worship associated with Kashi.
simp_chinese: 泰恩加西在泰米尔语中意为“南方迦尸”，名称反映了当地毗湿婆那他神庙的重要性。城镇宗教身份将本地潘地亚地区，同以迦尸相关崇拜为核心的更广阔神圣地理连接。

english: Tenkeli was established in the 1960s to exploit tin deposits in the Sakha north. The mining settlement grew to several thousand inhabitants before operations became uneconomic and it was abandoned in the 1990s.
simp_chinese: 坚克利于二十世纪六十年代为开采萨哈北部锡矿而建立。矿业聚落一度有数千居民，后来开采失去经济效益，于九十年代废弃。

english: Tenki belongs to the Yakutian country of Eastern Siberia. Across this vast geographical region, plateaus and tundra contrast with mountain ranges in the south. Yakutia shares this wider setting with Buryatia, Irkutsk and other Siberian territories.
simp_chinese: 坚基属于东西伯利亚的雅库特地区。整个广阔地理区内，高原与苔原同南方山脉构成不同景观。雅库特与布里亚特、伊尔库茨克等西伯利亚地域共享这一大区背景。

english: Tenkodogo was a historic Bissa-Mossi capital traditionally regarded as a root of the wider Mossi kingdoms. Founded around 1100, its name means ancient land, while neighbouring villages relied heavily on livestock raising.
simp_chinese: 滕科多戈是历史上的比萨—莫西都城，传统上被视为莫西诸王国的源头。它约于1100年建立，名称意为古老土地，邻近村庄则多以畜牧为生。

english: Tensas belongs to the wider Louisiana region of the lower Mississippi country. Louisiana lies between Texas and Mississippi, and its French heritage survives in the use of parishes as territorial divisions.
simp_chinese: 滕萨斯属于密西西比河下游的路易斯安那地区。路易斯安那位于得克萨斯与密西西比之间，以教区划分地方行政区的传统保留着法国影响。

english: Tenteksor belongs to the Sagiz country of the Kipchak steppe. The wider region was known in Persian as Dasht-i Qipchaq, a name reflecting the importance of Kipchak nomadic peoples in its medieval history.
simp_chinese: 坚特克索尔属于钦察草原的萨吉兹地区。更广阔的地区在波斯语中称达什特钦察，这一名称体现了钦察游牧诸族在其中世纪历史中的重要性。

english: Tenut belongs to the Agayakan basin of eastern Siberia. The wider river rises on the northern Suntar-Khayata slopes, crosses the Oymyakon Highlands and joins the Suntar to form the Kyuyente; snow and rain sustain its seasonal flow.
simp_chinese: 捷努特属于东西伯利亚阿加亚坎流域。河流发源于孙塔尔海亚塔山北坡，穿过奥伊米亚康高地，与孙塔尔河汇合成库恩捷河，水源来自融雪与降雨。

english: Teočak lies in northeastern Bosnia's Tuzla country. Its centre is the village of Teočak-Krstac, with the surrounding district adjoining Lopare, Ugljevik and Sapna.
simp_chinese: 泰奥恰克位于波斯尼亚东北部图兹拉地区。中心为泰奥恰克克尔斯塔茨村，周围辖区邻接洛帕雷、乌格列维克和萨普纳。

english: Rangiroa is the largest atoll in the Tuamotus and one of the largest in the world. Hundreds of islets and sandbars form its elongated reef rim, pierced by numerous narrow passages known as hoa.
simp_chinese: 朗伊罗阿是土阿莫土群岛最大的环礁，也是世界最大的环礁之一。数百座小岛与沙洲构成长形礁缘，其间穿插着众多称为hoa的狭窄水道。

english: Teotenanco belongs to the wider Michoacán setting of western Mexico. The larger region was the heartland of the Purépecha Empire, a rival of the Aztecs, and its Nahuatl name refers to fishermen associated with Lake Pátzcuaro.
simp_chinese: 特奥特南科处于墨西哥西部广义的米却肯区域。整个地区曾为与阿兹特克竞争的普雷佩查帝国腹地，其纳瓦特尔语名称指向帕茨夸罗湖的渔民。

english: Teotepec rises in Guerrero's Sierra Madre del Sur. At about 3,550 metres, the summit stands within the mountain country of Atoyac de Álvarez and General Heliodoro Castillo.
simp_chinese: 特奥特佩克耸立于格雷罗州的南马德雷山脉。峰顶高约3550米，位于阿托亚克‑德阿尔瓦雷斯和赫内拉尔‑埃利奥多罗‑卡斯蒂略的山地。

english: Teotitlan was an important religious altepetl in northern Oaxaca’s Canada region. Nahuatl-speaking Nonoalca inhabited the town, while Mazatec communities occupied much of its surroundings. Three priest-rulers governed it, and its subjects observed eighteen annual festivals and a four-year new-fire ceremony.
simp_chinese: 特奥蒂特兰是瓦哈卡北部卡尼亚达地区重要的宗教城邦。城中生活着说纳瓦特尔语的诺诺阿尔卡人，周边大片地区则由马萨特克社群居住。当地由三位祭司统治者治理，其属民举行十八项年度节庆与每四年一次的新火仪式。

english: Teozacualco belongs to Oaxaca in southern Mexico. Across this region, many communities retain recognized forms of local self-government grounded in customs and traditions.
simp_chinese: 特奥萨夸尔科属于墨西哥南部的瓦哈卡。这一地区的许多社群保留着以习惯与传统为基础、获得认可的地方自治形式。

english: Tecpatitlan belongs to the highlands of Jalisco, east of Guadalajara. The Tepatitlan district was inhabited by Otomi and later Tecuexe peoples before the Spanish-era foundation of the town in 1530.
simp_chinese: 特帕克蒂特兰属于瓜达拉哈拉以东的哈利斯科高地。特帕蒂特兰地区在1530年西班牙时期建城之前，先后有奥托米人与特库埃克塞人居住。

english: Tepecan belongs to northern Mexico’s Aridoamerican world. The wider region is marked by a dry climate, sparse rainfall and seasonal streams, conditions that shaped cultures distinct from greener Mesoamerican lands farther south.
simp_chinese: 特佩坎属于墨西哥北部的干旱美洲世界。更广阔的地区以干燥气候、稀少降雨与季节性溪流为特征，这些条件塑造了与南方较葱郁的美索美洲不同的文化。
